objective: Automatic PolypGen inference with YOLO initialization, Lean-SAM2, earlier-stage feature prompt refinement and CMSA-inspired multiscale memory-token scoring.
scope: The 21 sequences in the existing matched Lean/Native study; every manifest frame is evaluated. The sequence list was previously established using annotations, but no label is read to choose an initialization frame or construct any inference input.
detector: Run the existing polypgen_yolov8n checkpoint in chronological order until the first detection, confidence 0.25, IoU 0.7, input 640, class 0; use the highest-confidence box. Never use future frames or GT. If no detection appears, emit empty masks for the whole video. Do not re-detect after initialization.
prompt: Use Lean's released add_new_points_or_box to get an initial YOLO-box mask. From its own earlier-stage projected FPN feature map and this automatic provisional mask, form foreground/background prototypes with the existing project prompt_feature_refinement implementation. Choose its highest/lowest foreground-minus-background cosine margins inside the same YOLO box as positive/negative points; append them to the existing box and re-decode using the released predictor API. Supply the resulting automatic nonempty mask to Lean's mask-prompt API because released Lean initializes its anchor bank from mask prompts. If the provisional mask, background, or candidate grid is degenerate, use the automatic box-only prediction; if the final prediction is empty, keep the box-only point state and record that Lean's anchor may be unavailable. This is an adaptation, not a published CMSA or Lean prompt method.
memory: Reuse the project's lean_multiscale_anchor_v1 implementation: 0.5 local, 0.25 pooled-2, 0.25 pooled-4 anchor similarity in the original Lean TAMP cache. It uses a single Lean memory grid at multiple pooled scales, not CMSA's learned multistage CMA or distinct encoder-stage memory features. Keep original Lean TARR affinity and top-k budget.
evaluation: Report equal-sequence Dice on all labeled-present frames, false alarms on labeled-empty frames, detection index, pre-initialization misses, prompt fallbacks, and target-frame receipts. Also show a descriptive comparison to saved native and Lean scores on their historical post-GT-prompt targets, explicitly indicating the different initialization and evaluating the same frame IDs.
constraints: CPU float32, two threads, pinned Lean code and weights, no MPS. Store all experiment artifacts on requested Drive. No GT is used for inference. The detector training split is unknown, labels may be incomplete and the dataset was previously inspected; no independent-generalization claim.
verification: Unit tests, first-labeled-mask engineering no-op against saved Lean, two independent automatic full-sequence gates, exact output hashes and matching detections, unchanged model parameters, spatial-token indices and 25% retention, frame order checks, and independent pixel-level rescoring before interpreting results.
